name: print-social-cream-thank-you-slide-blurred-folders
title: Thank-you slide with heavy sans, blurred folders and a contact sticker
whatItIs: A cream slide with a bold chocolate 'thank you for watching!' headline, a paragraph with bold phrases, a big cursor arrow, three heavily blurred blue folders floating in the background, and a greyscale portrait with a 'contact me' script sticker with handles and a list of services.
whatItMeans: Warm and approachable; blurred folders keep the desktop theme without distracting.
techniques: Blur desktop icons in the background as texture.
Use a real cursor pointing at the call to action.
Attach an outlined script sticker to a portrait.
Bold key phrases inside a friendly paragraph.

vocabulary.definition: Out-of-focus interface elements used as decoration.
A script label attached to a portrait.
A cursor icon pointing to text.
The final slide with thanks and contact.
